Subscribe here . Shortly after 5 am ET tomorrow morning, while much of the East Coast is still in bed, Voyager 1 will cross a threshold that’s kind of hard to comprehend. The 49-year-old spacecraft will reach a point about 16 billion miles from Earth — the distance that light travels in 24 hours. Scientists call that unit a light-day. And while it’s not a particularly meaningful scientific measurement, it’s a pretty good opportunity to marvel at how far Voyager has voyaged. Dining with ASEAN in Manila allows Trump to check in with China’s southern neighbors like Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore, who together border the Strait of Malacca, the world’s busiest shipping channel. The project, in the Valley Center community, is a pilot program employing goat herds to remove vegetation and reduce wildfire risk. “It’s very, very helpful to local agencies to use these goats, to use these living mowers here, to make this place safe,” said Jake Enriquez, region manager for San Diego County Department of Parks and Recreation. As the animals crowded into the untreated field, mother does guided their kids to patches of grass, and larger animals stood up against an oak tree to browse the leaves. Five fluffy, white dogs – a mixed breed of Anatolian Shepherd and Great Pyrenees – patrolled the herd. A day before the three strongman leaders were set to meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation conference in Shenzhen, China, a Russian naval officer was filmed by Kremlin-controlled TV carrying an important briefcase. The “nuclear briefcase” known as Cheget, named after a mountain in the Greater Caucasus, is a command and control device that allows top Russian officials to authorize nuclear strikes remotely. It is typically carried by a naval officer and kept close to the president. Read more at The Daily Beast.

A natural choice of instrument, given that her father, Darryl “Chili” Charles, was a drummer himself . She’d put on her favorite records and play along: paying close attention to Joe Escalante of the Vandals, Lucky Lehrer of Circle Jerks and Philip “Fish” Fisher of Fishbone, at first, and then veering into post-punk: Lol Tolhurst of the Cure and Siouxsie and the Banshees’s Kenny Morris. “Having pocket, and then having the emotionality of being able to explode or retract, if I need to, or really break it down to the studs and be bare-boned—since I lacked the fundamentals and the technicality—it was all about that,” she said recently.
